padding_telemetry.interpretation: Router motion concentrates top-2 assignments while the current [experts,max_tokens,width] bmm pads every expert to the largest expert, increasing executed expert rows from approximately 2.4x to 4.0x the true assignment count.

implementation: retain the exact stable expert sort and selected probabilities
slice each expert's contiguous real assignments using the already computed counts
apply the same expert c_fc, GELU, and c_proj only to those rows
weight and index-add results with the identical sorted token indices and probabilities
unchanged: router logits, top-k selection, probabilities, and auxiliary losses
expert parameters, initialization, Muon ownership, and materialized/registered counts
generated QK function and packed-QKV repair
batching, global tokens, horizon, optimizer, learning rate, data, seeds, evaluations, and science thresholds

rationale: The same monotonic slowdown occurs in dense and mapped MoE, and direct telemetry identifies max-capacity zero padding as the cause. The current bmm path executes up to four times the real expert rows. A no-padding per-expert execution is an exact computational refactor, not a routing or architecture change, and is the only causally authorized next performance repair.
